name: the brown sugar babe

ingredients: 2 shots espresso (or 1/2 cup strong cold brew)
1 tsp brown sugar (or 1 tbsp sugar-free brown sugar syrup)
steps: shake espresso, brown sugar, cinnamon + ice in a jar for 10 sec
pour into a glass of ice

order: can i get a grande iced shaken espresso with oat milk, just 1 pump of brown sugar, and cinnamon on top?
tip: protein hack: swap half the oat milk for a vanilla protein shake = +15g protein
sass: same vibe, way less syrup. your barista won't even blink.
